battle.name: 霍邑之戰
battle.brief: 隋大義十三年（617）九月，關中薛舉父子據長安，李淵遣世民率精騎數百自馬邑冒雪疾行，破介休張寶，進逼霍邑；夜襲破城斬宋老生，隨即於淺水原以佯敗誘敵、側後突出破薛軍。卡面埃及長矛要靠密集步陣與遮蔽才發揮，與本役相隔近四千年；此役靠騎兵速度與溝壘取勝，長矛在追擊潰退中難有出手之機。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 這場戰爭是隋末關中爭奪中，唐國公李淵部與西秦皇帝薛舉部在霍邑至淺水原一線的對決，時間為隋大義十三年（唐武德元年）九月。唐方的指揮系統以太原起兵集團為核心：起兵時李淵任太原留守，掌河東兵馬，其子李建成、李世民、李元吉分領兵權，謀士劉文靜掌文書與軍需，起兵後以「唐國公」號令河東。作戰序列上，世民領的是一支輕裝精騎，負責解霍邑之圍並追擊，竇抗部則由晉陽南下策應。西秦方是關中起義的大宗，薛舉自稱西秦帝，國都長安，長子薛仁杲為秦王，總制關中兵馬；薛軍多關中、隴右及羌胡歸附部眾，騎兵比例高，習慣在關中平原與汾河谷地之間作長距馳突。隋朝在這一線已失去對地方的控制力，但其官軍仍據守城邑抵抗義軍，霍邑由太原郡丞宋老生領兵萬餘防守，介休由隋將張寶據守，長安則由右武衛大將軍屈突通死守至唐軍入城。竇抗原為隋河東郡丞，起義後一度抗唐，後歸唐並受封招討大將軍。整體看，交戰是兩支新興軍團爭奪關中入口，而隋的殘餘官軍是夾在中間、隨處倒向的第三方。
countriesEn: This war was a confrontation, inside the scramble over Guanzhong in the last years of the Sui, between the party of the Tang Prince of Li Yuan and the Western Qin regime of the emperor Xue Ju along the Huo Yi to Qianshuiyuan line, fought in the ninth month of the thirteenth year of Dayi, that is the first year of Wude, in 617. On the Tang side the command system was built around the Taiyuan uprising group. At the time of the rising Li Yuan was the governor of Taiyuan and held the soldiers and civil authority of Hedong; his three sons Li Jiancheng, Li Shimin and Li Yuanji held separate commands; the strategist Liu Wenjing handled documents and supply; and after the rising the whole party issued orders under the title Prince of Tang. In the order of battle Li Shimin led a light cavalry detachment charged with relieving Huo Yi and with the pursuit, while the column of Dou Kang marched south from Jinyang to support him. The Western Qin side was the largest of the Guanzhong insurgents. Xue Ju had proclaimed himself emperor of Western Qin with Chang'an as his capital, and had made his elder son Xue Rengao Prince of Qin with general control of the Guanzhong armies. Their troops came largely from Guanzhong and Longxi together with Qiang and Hu groups that had attached themselves to the revolt; the proportion of cavalry was high, and they were used to long rides across the Guanzhong plain and the Fen valley. The Sui had already lost control of the district, yet its official troops still held the walled towns and resisted the insurgents: Huo Yi was defended by Song Laosheng, Administrator of Taiyuan commandery, with more than ten thousand men; Jiexiu was held by the Sui general Zhang Bao; and Chang'an was defended to the end by the Right Wuwei General Qu Tutong, who held out until the Tang army entered the city. Dou Kang had been Administrator of Hedong under the Sui, resisted the Tang at first, and only came over after being won over, receiving the title General for Pacifying Hedong. Taken as a whole, the war was two new military groups contesting the gateway to Guanzhong, with the remnant Sui regulars as a third party in between, ready to side with whoever came out ahead.
people: 霍邑之戰的關鍵人物大半出自唐的開國集團。直接決定戰局的是李世民：起義初他以行軍總管身分領兵，堅持不解霍邑之圍，親率數百精騎冒雪疾行；抵達後主張夜襲而非久圍，攻城得手後又在淺水原主動挑戰，以佯敗把薛軍引入預設地。竇抗是關鍵的援軍：原為隋河東郡丞，起義後堅持與唐為敵，經說服後歸唐，被授河東招討大將軍，率部南下與世民會合，使唐軍在兵力上足以與薛軍正面對峙。劉文靜則是起義的策動者與後方支柱，他勸李淵舉兵、掌理軍中文書糧秣，起義後多留晉陽，籌措軍需與徵發。柴紹自太原起兵即與世民並騎，參與介休、霍邑一線的作戰；張公謹奉命留守晉陽，事後統軍追擊，段志玄率玄甲軍隨世民出戰，是淺水原迂迴中承接側擊的一支。敵方核心是薛舉與薛仁杲父子：薛舉在關中以威勢服眾，兵勢本盛，薛仁杲承其父之兵北向阻援，屢次增兵，戰術上善用騎兵正面壓制與追擊，卻在淺水原被引過溝壘而入死地，其前鋒猛將宗羅睺戰歿。隋方代表人物是宋老生與張寶：宋老生守霍邑，屢拒唐軍，兵敗被斬於城下；張寶據介休，糧盡夜遁被追獲。此外長安的屈突通在關中諸郡多附薛舉的情況下獨力堅守，牽制了薛軍的部分兵力。史書把霍邑的轉折點記在世民一人身上，其名將之望亦由此役確立。
peopleEn: Most of the key figures in the Battle of Huo Yi came out of the group that would found the Tang. The one who directly decided the battle was Li Shimin. Early in the rising he led troops as director of the marching army, insisted on relieving Huo Yi rather than leaving the siege in place, and personally led several hundred cavalry through the snow in a forced march; once there he argued for a night assault instead of a protracted siege, and after the city fell he fought the action at Qianshuiyuan on the offensive, drawing the Xue army into ground chosen in advance. Dou Kang was the decisive reinforcement: formerly Administrator of Hedong under the Sui, he had held out against the Tang after the rising and only came over after being persuaded, was then appointed General for Pacifying Hedong, and marched south to join Li Shimin, giving the Tang a force that could face the Xue army head on. Liu Wenjing was the instigator of the rising and the pillar of its rear: he had urged Li Yuan to take arms, handled the documents and the grain and clothing of the army, and after the rising stayed for the most part at Jinyang to raise money and men and to collect supplies. Chai Shao rode alongside Li Shimin from the start of the rising at Taiyuan and took part in the fighting at Jiexiu and Huo Yi; Zhang Gongjin was left to hold Jinyang and later led the pursuit, and Duan Zhixuan commanded the Black-armoured Guard that went out with Li Shimin and provided the flanking stroke at Qianshuiyuan. The core of the enemy command was the father and son Xue Ju and Xue Rengao. Xue Ju had subdued Guanzhong by force of reputation and his strength was great; Xue Rengao inherited his father's army, drove north to bar the relief, reinforced repeatedly, and was tactically skilled at pressing with cavalry head on and in pursuit, yet at Qianshuiyuan he was lured across the ditch and into the dead ground, where his fierce vanguard commander Zong Luohou fell in the fighting. The Sui side was represented by Song Laosheng and Zhang Bao: Song Laosheng held Huo Yi, refused the Tang again and again, and was cut down at the foot of the city when his army was beaten; Zhang Bao held Jiexiu and, with his grain exhausted, fled by night only to be overtaken and taken. Qu Tutong at Chang'an, meanwhile, held out alone while most of the Guanzhong commanderies had already gone over to Xue Ju, and so tied down part of the Xue army. The histories place the turning point at Huo Yi on Li Shimin alone, and his reputation as a great commander was established by this campaign.
kits: 卡面這件埃及長矛屬青銅時代工藝，是兵器譜系中長矛一類最原始的形制，與本役相隔近四千年，並不出現在霍邑的戰場上；把它放在此役，是要標示「矛」這個兵種在六百餘年後的北方戰場上仍然是最基本也最普及的近身兵器。霍邑與淺水原兩役中真正上陣的是唐的鐵製長兵器：步兵所持的長矛與兩側帶刃的槊，用於列陣抵禦與近身格鬥；騎兵則用馬槊，衝鋒時挾槊而前，專取騎兵交鋒的一瞬。弓弩是兩軍共有的主兵器，唐軍以臂弓、角弓配箭簇，遠近皆備，另有蹶張弩一類強弩，用於守城與攻城的定點壓制。防具方面，唐軍已有明光甲一類鐵甲片札甲與皮甲並行，軍中披甲比例隨戰役而增，馬鎧則用於重騎突擊。薛軍以關中騎兵為主，弓矢配置密集，長刀與矛槊並用，作戰風格偏向奔馳包抄而非正面硬撼。攻城方面，霍邑是土築城垣，唐軍主力抵達時用的是夜襲破門而非器械攻擊；同一年稍後進攻長安時，唐軍才大量使用衝車、巢車與雲梯。運輸與補給方面，唐軍自晉陽南下，靠馬匹、驢騾馱運甲兵與糧秣，淺水原一役因距太原不遠，得以輕裝疾行、放手追擊，這也是唐軍敢於分兵深入的前提。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card is a Bronze Age piece, the oldest form of the spear family in the whole lineage of arms, and it stands nearly four thousand years away from this campaign; it never appeared on the field at Huo Yi. Setting it here marks the point that the spear, that single weapon type, was still the most basic and most widespread close-combat arm in the northern battles of six hundred years later. What actually fought at Huo Yi and Qianshuiyuan were the Tang iron pole-arms. The foot soldiers carried the long spear and the double-edged sao, used to hold a line and to fight at close quarters, while the cavalry carried the horse spear, coming on with it couched, aiming at the instant when the two mounted formations closed. The bow and the crossbow were the principal arms of both armies: the Tang used the single-arm bow and the composite bow with arrow heads, ready at both short and long range, and they also had heavy crossbows of the type drawn by the feet, employed for fixed-point pressure in the defence and assault of walls. On protection, the Tang already wore plate and lamellar armour of the mingguang type together with leather armour, the proportion of armoured men rising as the campaign went on, while horse armour was used for the charge of heavy cavalry. The Xue army was mounted in the main, with dense bow and arrow holdings, using long sabres together with spears and sao, and its style leaned towards riding down and enveloping the enemy rather than grinding head-on at a wall. On siege: Huo Yi was a rammed-earth walled town, and the Tang did not bring up siege engines against it but struck the gate by night; only later in the same year, against Chang'an, did the Tang use battering rams, siege towers and scaling ladders in quantity. On movement and supply, the Tang marched south from Jinyang, carrying armour, weapons and grain on horses, donkeys and mules, and because Qianshuiyuan lay close to Taiyuan they were able to travel light, to strike hard and to pursue without stint, which was the premise that allowed the army to operate so far inside enemy country.
tactics: 唐軍此役的戰術主軸是輕兵疾進加側翼包抄，與隋末多數野戰中兵多而將弱、純靠撞擊的作法完全不同。第一段是解圍：世民以數百精騎捨棄大隊，倍道兼程，走馬邑至介休、霍邑之間的汾水谷道，避開正面受敵的糾纏，等於把薛軍的圍城部隊置於側後。抵達霍邑後不急於攻城，先以夜襲取城，再會竇抗之兵，使唐軍在霍邑一地同時具備攻城能力與野戰能力。第二段是淺水原的伏擊：唐軍先依地勢在淺水原一側列陣，另留精兵埋伏於原北溝谷之間；世民自將數百騎出陣挑戰，接戰後佯作不支，節節退卻，薛軍騎兵見敵勢弱，紛紛追擊，隊形因追擊而拉長，一過溝壘，唐軍伏兵即由側後突出，先以弩箭齊射壓制，再以騎兵反覆衝擊被拉開的敵隊縱隊；史書記唐軍一度振臂而噪、士卒踴躍爭進，兩翼合圍之後，薛軍主力在原野上被分割吞沒，斬首數萬，收降八萬，追擊一直抵達薛仁杲退守的折墜城下。守城階段，世民不以器械硬攻，而是在城四面多張旌旗、擊鼓進兵，使城中與城外的薛軍誤判援兵到來，軍心先潰，再趁夜襲取。第三段是追擊與收編：破城之後，唐軍不戀戰，即時整軍追亡逐北，把薛仁杲部逐出關中要道，同時收編降卒充實兵員。整體而言，此役是內線作戰的典型：以短補給線換取戰術主動，用佯敗與側擊放大少量精騎的破壞力，再用追擊把一次會戰的成果轉成對關中的戰略支配。
tacticsEn: The tactical axis of the Tang army in this campaign was light troops moving fast and striking the flanks, completely unlike the massed but badly led battles of the late Sui, which settled everything by collision. The first phase was the relief: Li Shimin left the main body behind with several hundred cavalry, marched at double speed, and took the Fen valley road between Mayi, Jiexiu and Huo Yi, refusing to be drawn into a frontal contest and thereby placing the Xue besieging force behind his own line. On reaching Huo Yi he did not hurry to batter the walls: he took the town by night first and then joined Dou Kang's troops, so that in one place the Tang had both the capacity to take walled towns and the capacity to fight a pitched battle. The second phase was the ambush at Qianshuiyuan. The Tang drew up on one side of the rise according to the ground and posted picked troops in the gullies to the north of it; Li Shimin went out in person with several hundred horsemen to give battle, and after contact feigned collapse and fell back step by step. The Xue cavalry, seeing the enemy falter, gave chase in disorder, and the shape of their formation stretched out in the pursuit; the moment they crossed the ditch and the rampart, the ambush sprang from the flank and rear, first shooting home with crossbow bolts and then hammering the lengthened column over and over with cavalry. The histories record that the Tang troops at one point raised their arms and shouted, the soldiers leaping forward in competition to advance; once the two wings had closed, the main body of the Xue army was cut up and swallowed on the open plain, several thousand heads were taken, some eighty thousand men surrendered, and the pursuit carried on to the foot of Zhezhuicheng, where Xue Rengao had shut himself up. In the siege phase Li Shimin did not press the town with engines, but had banners raised on all four sides and drums beaten with the advance sounded, so that the Xue troops inside and outside the wall misjudged the arrival of relief, lost their nerve first, and could then be taken by night. The third phase was pursuit and consolidation: after the town fell the Tang did not linger, but rallied at once and drove the enemy before them, pushing Xue Rengao's troops off the main roads of Guanzhong, while at the same time incorporating the surrendered men to fill out the ranks. In overall terms this campaign is a classic of interior lines: a short supply line bought tactical freedom, a feigned defeat and a flank stroke multiplied the destructive effect of a handful of good horsemen, and the pursuit converted the result of a single engagement into strategic command of Guanzhong.
data: 有根據可寫的數字大致如下。唐軍此役的先頭部隊，史書多作「精騎數百」，亦有記為數千，約在數百至一千餘之間；竇抗率晉陽南下之援軍人數，史無明文。介休一役，唐軍破隋將張寶所部，俘獲及裹脅之眾約萬餘人；霍邑城破，斬宋老生於城下，隨軍被俘萬餘，此數與兩城守軍的規模相合。淺水原一戰，薛仁杲傾關中之眾來援，兵數通常概稱十萬；唐軍先以輕騎誘敵，戰後記載斬首數萬，收降卒八萬，其後追至折墜城，薛仁杲部夜潰被擒。降卒八萬這個數字，歷來史家多認為有誇大，但可確定的是薛軍主力在這一役中損失慘重，唐軍由此獲得大量可以編入的降卒，兵勢為之大盛，能以充足兵力經營關中，與此直接相關。行程方面，馬邑（今山西忻州馬邑區）至霍邑（今山西霍州）約二百餘公里，中經介休；唐代一里約合今五百三十五公尺，九月的汾河谷地已入深秋，雨雪交加，士卒嚴寒，馬匹難行，一度因雪阻滯。時間上，從出兵到霍邑城破、淺水原大敗，前後不出一個月，屬隋末戰役中推進最快的一類。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. The vanguard the Tang sent into this campaign is described in the histories as several hundred picked cavalry, sometimes as several thousand, somewhere between a few hundred and a little over a thousand; the number of the reinforcements Dou Kang marched south from Jinyang is not recorded. At Jiexiu the Tang broke the troops of the Sui general Zhang Bao and took or swept up some ten thousand men; when Huo Yi fell, Song Laosheng was cut down at the foot of the city and more than ten thousand of his men were taken, a figure consistent with the garrison sizes of the two towns. At Qianshuiyuan Xue Rengao brought the strength of Guanzhong to the field, customarily reckoned at a hundred thousand; the Tang first drew them on with light cavalry, and the aftermath records several thousand heads taken and eighty thousand men surrendered, the pursuit continuing to Zhezhuicheng, where Xue Rengao's troops broke up at night and he was taken. The figure of eighty thousand surrendered has long been regarded by historians as exaggerated, but what is certain is that the Xue main force suffered heavily in this one campaign, and that the Tang gained a large body of men fit to be incorporated, which swelled their strength and gave them the numbers to hold Guanzhong; this was directly connected. As to distance, the road from Mayi, in today's Mayi district of Xinzhou in Shanxi, to Huo Yi, today's Huozhou in Shanxi, is a little over two hundred kilometres and runs through Jiexiu; a Tang li was about 535 modern metres, and in the ninth month the Fen valley had already turned hard into late autumn, with rain and snow, soldiers suffering the cold and horses finding the going difficult, at one point the column being held up by the snow. As to time, from the march leaving to the fall of Huo Yi and the rout at Qianshuiyuan less than a month elapsed, which places it among the fastest-moving campaigns of the late Sui.
cause: 霍邑之戰的起因是隋末關中與河東的權力真空，而不是某一場具體衝突被升級。隋文帝之後天下日益疲敝，隋煬帝的連年征發、洛陽工程與對高句麗的戰爭耗盡民力，大業十三年（617）各地同時爆發起義，其中關中一帶有薛舉、隴西梁師都等部響應，李密在河南另成一大勢力，長安與洛陽兩端的隋朝官軍被逐一消耗。薛舉於是趁勢取關中、入長安，自稱西秦帝，把持了從太原南下的關鍵通道。李淵同年二月在太原起兵，握有河東的人、兵、糧，卻被薛軍阻在霍邑一線以南，主力不能南下，關中無從爭取。於是霍邑成了必爭之地：守住霍邑，薛軍就能維持對關中的控制，並把唐軍長久隔絕在太原；打下霍邑，唐軍便可直下汾水、渭水，進入關中與薛軍爭奪生存空間。值得注意的是，這場戰爭同時也是李淵集團內部的權力競逐。李建成以太子身份留守太原主持後方，李世民以軍事統帥身分主張速取關中，兄弟之間在戰略與兵權上的分歧，本役的指揮權歸世民，也讓他在軍中建立了超越兄長的威望。李淵事後論功，授世民陝東行臺尚書令、太原行軍元帥，更授以揮軍汾渭的權柄。
causeEn: The cause of the Battle of Huo Yi was the vacuum of power in Guanzhong and Hedong in the last years of the Sui, rather than the escalation of any one specific clash. After Emperor Wen the empire wore steadily thinner; under Emperor Yang the repeated levies, the works at Luoyang and the campaigns against Goguryeo drained the country, and in the thirteenth year of Dayi, 617, risings broke out everywhere at once, with Xue Ju in Guanzhong and Liang Shidu in Longxi among the groups that rose in the west, Li Mi raising a separate great power in Henan, and the Sui regulars at the two ends of the realm, Chang'an and Luoyang, being worn down one by one. Xue Ju took advantage of this to seize Guanzhong and enter Chang'an, proclaimed himself emperor of Western Qin, and held the key road down from Taiyuan. Li Yuan rose at Taiyuan in the second month of the same year, holding the men, the soldiers and the grain of Hedong, yet Xue forces barred his way south of the Huo Yi line, so that his main army could not march down and Guanzhong could not be contested. Huo Yi therefore became a place that had to be fought for: by holding it the Xue could keep their grip on Guanzhong and hold the Tang at arm's length beyond Taiyuan for a long time; by taking it the Tang could descend the Fen and the Wei, enter Guanzhong and fight the Xue for the same living space. It is worth noting that the war was at the same time a contest of power inside Li Yuan's own group. Li Jiancheng stayed at Taiyuan as crown prince, running the rear, while Li Shimin, the commander in the field, argued for a quick seizure of Guanzhong; the division between the brothers over strategy and command was settled here by giving the command to Shimin, which also built him a reputation in the army beyond that of his elder brother. After the campaign Li Yuan rewarded Li Shimin with the post of President of the Eastern Capital Office and Grand General of the Taiyuan Army, granting him the authority to direct troops in the Fen and Wei valleys.
impact: 霍邑與淺水原兩役的結果，直接改變了隋末北方的力量對比，也改變了唐集團內部的權力格局。在關中層面，薛舉的西秦政權在兩場戰鬥中失去了全部野戰主力，薛仁杲被擒、薛舉病亡，關中各郡邑多望風歸唐，李淵於同年十一月率軍進入長安，迎隋恭帝遷都，翌年正月隋恭帝遜位，唐朝建立。從割據一方到問鼎天下，差距就在霍邑這一步。次年唐軍在洛陽一戰大破竇建德、逼降王世充，得以兼有河北與中原，也是在關中站穩之後才可能做到的事。在集團內部，世民因霍邑、淺水原兩役的戰功取得李淵與諸將的推重，兵權與威望都超越建成，雖然太子之位一度歸建成，最終的皇位還是落在世民手上；史家謂玄武門之變的伏筆，其實起於此役的軍功。戰術層面的影響更為長久：淺水原之役以數百輕騎拖住並引誘數倍乃至十倍之敵，再以側擊破之，後世兵家把它與淺水、淝水一類的著名會戰並列為中國古代伏擊戰的範本，歷代講武的兵書都反覆講述其地形利用與誘敵之法。對北方邊疆而言，薛舉覆亡後關中再無西秦式的割據力量，唐朝得以把精力轉向突厥與西域，其對內亞草原的政策基調也在此役之後奠定。
impactEn: The outcome of the two engagements at Huo Yi and Qianshuiyuan directly changed the balance of power in northern China in the last years of the Sui, and they changed the internal balance of the Tang group as well. At the Guanzhong level the Western Qin government of Xue Ju lost its entire field army in two battles: Xue Rengao was taken and Xue Ju died of illness, the commanderies of Guanzhong went over to the Tang as the news spread, and in the eleventh month of that same year Li Yuan led his army into Chang'an, escorted the Emperor Gong of the Sui to the new capital, and in the first month of the following year the Emperor Gong yielded the throne and the Tang dynasty was founded. The distance between being one more regional power and claiming the empire came down to this single step at Huo Yi. The next year's battle at Luoyang, in which the Tang army destroyed Dou Jiande and compelled Wang Shichong to surrender and so held both Hebei and the Central Plain at once, was only possible because they had first made themselves secure in Guanzhong. Inside the group, Li Shimin drew the support of Li Yuan and the generals for his performance at Huo Yi and Qianshuiyuan; his authority and his reputation both passed beyond those of Jiancheng, and although the position of crown prince for a time belonged to the elder brother, the imperial seat eventually went to Shimin. Historians say that the seeds of the Xuanwu Gate incident were in fact planted in the military renown won in this campaign. The tactical consequences are even more durable: at Qianshuiyuan a few hundred light horsemen held off and drew on an enemy several times, even ten times, their number, and then broke it with a stroke from the flank, and later military writers placed it alongside the classic Chinese battles of ambush as a model, with the textbooks of the martial tradition returning again and again to its use of the ground and its method of luring the enemy. On the northern frontier as well, once Xue Ju had fallen there was no longer a Western Qin style separatist force in Guanzhong, the Tang could turn its energy towards the Turks and the Western Regions, and the basic line of Tang policy towards the steppe of Inner Asia was set after this campaign.
result: 霍邑之戰以唐軍完勝收場。介休一戰，隋將張寶據城拒守，兵盡糧絕夜遁，被唐軍追獲；霍邑城下，唐軍連夜進攻，隋將宋老生兵敗投馬，被斬於門下，隨軍萬餘人被俘，霍邑落入唐軍之手，竇抗所率援軍亦抵達會合。薛仁杲聞霍邑失守，親率大軍趨援，列陣於淺水原；世民以數百精騎出陣挑戰，故意敗退，薛軍追過溝壘，唐軍伏兵突出，兩翼合擊，薛軍十萬眾一朝崩潰，斬首數萬，降卒八萬，軍心與兵勢同時瓦解。薛仁杲退保折墜城，唐軍逼近城下，多張旌旗、擊鼓進兵，薛軍以為唐軍大至，夜間潰散，薛仁杲為唐軍追獲，隨軍送長安。西秦薛舉聞訊發病而死，關中群雄失去領袖，唐軍於同年十一月入長安，翌年正月改元武德，李淵即帝位。就此役本身而言，結果是三重的：霍邑與介休兩城易主，關中通道被打通；薛仁杲所部十萬之眾一敗而散，唐軍收編降卒而兵力大盛；李世民以孤軍深入破城的戰功，在唐初的軍政格局中取得壓倒性的名位，一場原本只涉及兩座城池與一條谷道的戰鬥，成為唐朝取代隋朝、統一北方的起點。
resultEn: The Battle of Huo Yi ended in a complete Tang victory. At Jiexiu the Sui general Zhang Bao held the town in defiance, and when his men and his grain were exhausted he fled by night and was overtaken and taken by the Tang. Before Huo Yi the Tang attacked through the night, the Sui general Song Laosheng was beaten, threw himself from his horse and was cut down at the gate; more than ten thousand of his men were taken, Huo Yi fell into Tang hands, and the reinforcements under Dou Kang also arrived and joined. Hearing that Huo Yi had been lost, Xue Rengao came up in person with the main army and drew it up at Qianshuiyuan. Li Shimin went out with several hundred picked cavalry, fought and gave ground deliberately, the Xue pursued across the ditch and rampart, the Tang ambush burst out and the two wings closed: the hundred thousand men of the Xue army collapsed at once, several thousand heads were taken, eighty thousand surrendered, and both morale and formation were destroyed together. Xue Rengao fell back on Zhezhuicheng; the Tang pressed up to the walls, raised banners on all sides and sounded the advance with drums, the Xue, believing a great Tang force had arrived, scattered in the night, and Xue Rengao was overtaken by the Tang and sent to Chang'an in the company of his troops. Xue Ju of Western Qin, hearing the news, fell ill and died; the rebel chiefs of Guanzhong lost their leader, and in the eleventh month of the same year the Tang entered Chang'an, in the first month of the next year the era name Wude was proclaimed and Li Yuan took the imperial seat. In the end the result of this campaign was threefold. Huo Yi and Jiexiu changed hands and the road into Guanzhong was opened. The hundred thousand men under Xue Rengao were scattered by a single defeat, and the Tang army grew strong by taking the surrendered men into its ranks. And Li Shimin, through the renown of driving a lone column into the enemy's rear and breaking a walled town, obtained a dominating place in the military and political order of the early Tang; a battle that on its face concerned only two walled towns and one valley road became the starting point of the Tang replacing the Sui and uniting the north.
